lines.text: We gather at the temporary camp and share our findings:
the murals on the stone pillar and the lighthouse,
and the faint tremors we've felt beneath the ground.
But none of it leads us to any clear conclusions yet.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: There were so many reptiles, Teacher!

lines.speaker: peng4
lines.text: I'll never forget that taste. Peng.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: So you were just out having fun, huh.
Good. We came all this way for a vacation, so take it easy.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: So let's call it a day for today's investigation, okay?

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: We're finally at the beach, and we've barely even gotten to enjoy it.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: I wanna go play in the water!

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Here I put on a swimsuit, and I still haven't had the chance to get in the water.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: ... Are you saying we should be having fun in a situation like this?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: There's nothing more we can uncover right now, and everyone's clearly exhausted.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: so it would be wiser to rest while we can.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Proper rest is what will allow us to function at our best tomorrow.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Staying on edge all the time wears down your judgment.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: Resting when you can is part of the strategy.
So how about we just take it easy for today?

lines.speaker: peng4
lines.text: I've always wanted to play in the ocean! Peng!
Siren doesn't follow and just stands there hesitantly.
Little Mermaid rushes to catch up and nearly trips. I catch her before she falls.
Naga glances between Little Mermaid and me, then gives a small smile.

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Ah, so that's what this is about.

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: ... Oh! I get it now, hehe.
Am I the only one who doesn't know what's going on?

lines.speaker: naga_s
lines.text: Tia, you can't just do that out of nowhere...!

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Hehe, you should see your faces!

lines.speaker: tia_l
lines.text: Ack! It got in my eyes!
With a small wave of Little Mermaid's hand,
water fans outward in a massive arc before crashing over us like a wave.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid_s
lines.text: I-I'm sorry! I didn't mean to do that...!
The three girls laugh and start splashing water at each other again.
Meanwhile, Penguin No. 4 and I watch from the sidelines.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: You look like you're enjoying yourself, Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi_ss
lines.text: It's almost like you've been waiting for this moment all along.
Fine, I'm not going easy on you anymore. Take this!
Mori digs into the sand with a shovel while Grave and Penguin No. 3 watch from the side.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: G-Grave... what kind of training is this exactly?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Maintaining the same posture while repeating the same motions for long periods

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I heard digging is your specialty.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Then you'd better put more effort into it.
Mori slowly pushes herself upright, catching her breath.
When she finally looks up, the hole is already as deep as her height.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: You're right, I can't get out on my own!

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Next time, don't push yourself too hard.

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: So what does "not pushing myself too hard" even mean?
Penguin No. 3 watches Grave pull Mori out of the hole,
Marciana sits off to one side of the beach, watching everyone have fun.
Cinderella sits down beside Marciana and hands her a drink.
Meanwhile, Penguin No. 1 sits down next to Cinderella and starts drinking too.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Where did you get this from?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Not sure, but it looks like this little one's been taking care of it.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Hm...? You're wearing a different swimsuit?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Yes, Grave prepared this for me.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: It's black, so I figured it would suit the evening better than the daytime, so I tried it on.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: My little friend here helped me change into it.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Have you... decided to keep attending to Cinderella, Penguin No. 1?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: You're not going into the water?

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I'll stay here and keep watch.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I didn't realize that was why.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Look at them. Even your students are out there having fun.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: If their teacher sits here with such a tense expression, wouldn't that only make them more anxious?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: At least dip your feet in.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: What kind of penguin comes all the way to the ocean just to stand there and watch?

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I-I told you, I'm not a penguin!

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Doesn't being away from your friends make you anxious?

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: When everyone split up into groups earlier,

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: you didn't seem particularly anxious about being separated from your friends.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: If anything, you seemed remarkably calm.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Why would I feel anxious just because we're apart?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: so I have no reason to be anxious.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Well, I can't tell you everything,

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: but we've been through a lot together.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: There were times we were apart much longer than this, for reasons far worse.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: Back then, we didn't even know if we'd ever see each other again.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: But somehow, we always ended up meeting again.

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: As long as we kept believing, as long as our hearts were still with each other, somehow we'd always find each other again.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: Simply by believing in each other?

lines.speaker: cinderella_s
lines.text: I'm sure it'll be the same for you and your students too.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: I was thinking of turning on the lighthouse.

lines.speaker: marciana_s
lines.text: As you can see, everyone else seems to be busy...
